# Stacy

## Overview

- **Age:** young  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman with lovely fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears sleeve puffs larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is bright, sympathetic, and cheerful. She possesses the natural ability to win and hold the affection of her pupils, bringing out the best in them both mentally and morally. She is an encouraging mentor who maintains perfect discipline without resorting to physical punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is hired as the schoolteacher in Avonlea, becoming the town's first female teacher. She introduces physical culture exercises, biweekly recitation afternoons, and outdoor field days to study nature. She establishes a deep rapport with her students and forms the Queen's class to thoroughly prepare advanced pupils for the Entrance examinations. When Anne Shirley is caught reading a novel during class time, Miss Stacy counsels her privately on honesty and time management, winning Anne's deep devotion. After guiding her Queen's class students through their successful Entrance examinations, she concludes her term of teaching in Avonlea. She later returns for visits to Avonlea, during which she attends social gatherings such as a dinner with guests including Mr. and Mrs. Allan.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c31 P10](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0010), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022), [v2 c17 P55](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0055)_
